C0244.title: 机器学习用于电子邮件垃圾邮件过滤的综述研究
C0244.summary: 2019年Heliyon发表《Machine learning for email spam filtering: review, approaches and open research problems》。论文综述电子邮件垃圾过滤中的机器学习方法、特征提取和分类评估，讨论垃圾邮件识别的数据集、对抗变化与开放研究问题。

references.title: Machine learning for email spam filtering: review, approaches and open research problems
